title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.00493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank

translated_title: 评分更新，而非词元：面向组合式LoRA专家的下降对齐路由
translated_abstract: 混合LoRA专家方法通过将每个词元路由到少量低秩专家来提升低秩适配的能力。几乎所有现有方法都将每个专家的一个输入侧因子与一个输出侧因子绑定，并且几乎所有方法都通过为词元打分来进行路由：路由器在选择专家时，根本看不到任何一个专家实际会写出什么样的更新。我们认为路由器应该为更新打分。在一阶近似下，将某专家的更新加入层输出所降低的损失，等于该更新与输出处负损失梯度之间的内积。这种有用性关于词元是二次的，因此关于词元线性的路由器只能看到经由词元均值传递的那一部分；而通过自身激活范数对专家排序的路由器则完全看不到输出侧因子。如果将每个专家拆分为读取器（下投影）和写入器（上投影），那么每一对读取器-写入器组合的有用性就变成共享秩空间中的内积。
tldr: 该论文提出路由器应基于专家更新与负损失梯度的内积（即下降对齐）来为“更新”打分而非为“词元”打分，并通过将LoRA专家拆分为读取器与写入器的组合来实现组合式专家路由。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes that routers should score each LoRA expert's update by its descent alignment (inner product with the negative loss gradient) rather than scoring the token, enabling combinatorial routing over reader-writer expert pairs.
